name: GitHub MCP Server (remote, hosted by GitHub)
description: GitHub-hosted remote endpoint https://api.githubcopilot.com/mcp/ for the github/github-mcp-server project. One catalog item per transport packaging is a v1 workaround because spec_mcp_server.transport is single-valued; the local stdio packaging is mcp_server.github-local.

provenance.notes: Official MCP Registry entry io.github.github/github-mcp-server, version 2.0.2, status active, published 2026-10-08; remotes[0].type streamable-http at https://api.githubcopilot.com/mcp/ with a secret Authorization header (PAT or App token). Supports version, transport. trust_level is a t4c research suggestion, not a security approval: trusted_external = maintained by the vendor whose API it fronts or by a named organisation, with publisher identity checked against the official MCP Registry namespace or the vendor's own docs; it does not make returned content trusted (see note, #35).

README: remote server hosted by GitHub; configuration shown 'Using OAuth' and 'Using a GitHub PAT' (Authorization: Bearer); GitHub Enterprise Server does not support remote hosting; ghe.com uses copilot-api.<sub>.ghe.com/mcp. Supports auth_methods. auth_methods records the credential types the server accepts from the client or its environment: oauth2 = MCP authorization (OAuth 2.1) or an upstream OAuth login; api_key = a static bearer/personal/agent token passed by header or environment variable.
Release v2.0.2 exists and is marked Latest (08 Oct). Supports version.
